title: Molecular insights of Eucalyptol (1,8-Cineole) as an anti-arthritic agent: in vivo and in silico analysis of IL-17, IL-10, NF-kappaB, 5-LOX and COX-2.
authors: Iqbal, Urooj; Malik, Abdul; Sial, Nabeela Tabassum; Uttra, Ambreen Malik; Rehman, Muhammad Fayyaz Ur; Mehmood, Malik Hassan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桉叶油素抗关节炎作用，分子对接仅针对小分子与炎症蛋白（非DNA），无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The monoterpene oxide, Eucalyptol (1,8-Cineole), a primary component of eucalyptus oil, has been evaluated pharmacologically for anti-inflammatory and analgesic activity. Current research aimed to evaluate Eucalyptol's anti-arthritic potential in a Complete Freund's adjuvant induced arthritis that resembles human rheumatoid arthritis. Polyarthritis developed after 0.1 mL CFA injection into the left hind footpad in rats. Oral administration of Eucalyptol at various doses (100, 200 and 400 mg/kg) significantly reduced paw edema, body weight loss, 5-LOX, PGE2 and Anti-CCP levels. Real-time PCR investigation showed significant downregulation of COX-2, TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB, IL-17, IL-6, IL-1beta and upregulation of IL-4 and IL-10 in Eucalyptol treated groups. Hemoglobin and RBCs counts significantly increased post-treatment with Eucalyptol while ESR, CRP, WBCs and platelets count significantly decreased. Eucalyptol significantly increased Superoxide Dismutase, Catalase and Glutathione levels compared to CFA-induced arthritic control however, MDA significantly decreased post-treatment. Further, radiographic and histopathological examination of the ankle joints of rodents administered Eucalyptol revealed an improvement in the structure of the joints. Piroxicam was taken as standard. Furthermore, molecular docking findings supported the anti-arthritic efficacy of Eucalyptol exhibited high binding interaction against IL-17, TNF-alpha, IL-4, IL-10, iNOS NF-kappaB, 5-LOX, and COX-2. Eucalyptol has reduced the severity of CFA induced arthritis by promoting anti-inflammatory cytokines for example IL-4, IL-10 and by inhibiting pro-inflammatory cytokines such as 5-LOX, COX-2, IL-17, NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, IL-6 and IL-1beta. Therefore, Eucalyptol might be as a potential therapeutic agent because of its pronounced anti-oxidant and anti-arthritic activity.
abstract_zh: 单萜氧化物——桉叶油素（1,8-桉叶素），作为桉树油的主要成分，已在药理学上评估其抗炎和镇痛活性。当前研究旨在评估桉叶油素在完全弗氏佐剂诱导的关节炎（类似于人类类风湿性关节炎）中的抗关节炎潜力。在大鼠左后足垫注射0.1 mL CFA后，出现多发性关节炎。口服不同剂量（100、200和400 mg/kg）的桉叶油素显著减轻了足爪水肿、体重下降、5-LOX、PGE2和抗CCP水平。实时PCR研究显示，在桉叶油素处理组中，COX-2、TNF-α、NF-κB、IL-17、IL-6、IL-1β显著下调，而IL-4和IL-10上调。桉叶油素处理后，血红蛋白和红细胞计数显著增加，而ESR、CRP、白细胞和血小板计数显著降低。与CFA诱导的关节炎对照组相比，桉叶油素显著增加了超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽水平，然而MDA在处理后显著降低。此外，对接受桉叶油素处理的啮齿动物踝关节的放射学和组织病理学检查显示，关节结构有所改善。吡罗昔康作为标准对照。进一步，分子对接结果支持桉叶油素的抗关节炎功效，其与IL-17、TNF-α、IL-4、IL-10、iNOS、NF-κB、5-LOX和COX-2表现出高结合相互作用。桉叶油素通过促进抗炎细胞因子（如IL-4、IL-10）和抑制促炎细胞因子（如5-LOX、COX-2、IL-17、NF-κB、TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β）来减轻CFA诱导的关节炎严重程度。因此，桉叶油素因其显著的抗氧化和抗关节炎活性，可能成为一种潜在的治疗剂。
